name: Miro
summary: Visual collaboration platform: an infinite online whiteboard for brainstorms, diagrams, workshops and planning — with templates, voting and AI that generates diagrams and summaries, built for real-time and async teamwork.
best_for: teams that think visually — brainstorms, flowcharts, retros, workshops and planning on an infinite shared canvas with strong templates and facilitation tools
skip_if: your work is mostly documents or task tracking (a doc or PM tool fits better) or most of your company would only ever need to view, not edit
honest_knock: Per-member pricing charges for every member added to the workspace, so an org-wide rollout multiplies at full headcount — and the free plan's 3-board cap is workspace-wide, not per person, so a team reaches it as soon as it needs a fourth editable board. Model who truly needs to edit before you buy seats.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-23 on miro.com/pricing/) Free plan: 3 editable boards workspace-wide, unlimited members, AI shown as a limited trial in the plan table, which the FAQ puts at 10 credits a month. Starter $8/member/mo and Business $20/member/mo, both billed yearly; Enterprise custom priced from 30 members. The yearly toggle is marked save 20%, which puts the monthly rates at $10 and $25. AI credits are published per plan: 25 per member per month on Starter, 50 on Business. MCP calls are a separate published meter: 500 a day on Starter, 2,000 on Business. Currency note: the served page defaults to USD, but rendered from a Dutch connection the same numerals appear as €8 and €20, so the symbol follows the visitor region. Enterprise starts from 2,500 AI credits a month, scaling with seats and pooled org-wide, and 10,000 MCP calls a day; Free gets 100 MCP calls a day. Credits are pooled across the organisation, reset monthly without rollover, and extra credit packages can be bought. Guests (free accounts invited to specific boards, no paid seat) exist only on Business and Enterprise; on Free anyone invited becomes a member. 14-day Business trial. Startups under 30 employees can get $500 or $1,000 in Miro credits.

compare_with.name: FigJam or Lucidspark
compare_with.why: FigJam wins if your designers already live in Figma, Lucidspark on diagram-heavy work; Miro wins on breadth: templates, integrations and workshop facilitation
